resources.string: AeroChat talks to nearby phones only via Bluetooth: without \"Nearby devices\", chats, games and the radar don\'t work. Allow it for AeroChat in Settings.
The camera is used to take photos and scan QR codes and boarding passes. Allow it for AeroChat in Settings.
The microphone is used for voice notes and calls. Allow it for AeroChat in Settings.
Location is only used to attach it to an emergency alert. Allow it for AeroChat in Settings.
Without notifications you won\'t know when a message arrives while the app is closed. Turn them on for AeroChat in Settings.
